description: Permanent dynamic batch geography for Gabriel 144-dossier batches (owner directive 2026-11-02). No batch geography is hard-coded to Dallas: for a requested state, Gabriel resolves (1) the most populated city, (2) the 12 most populated counties of that city's metropolitan area (OMB metropolitan + combined statistical area counties), and (3) a diversity matrix of 4 candidates x 3 canonical property categories x 12 counties = 144. Legacy Dallas/DFW searches keep the existing DFW roster (app/agents/gabriel/geography.py) and the existing pilot ledger; this contract governs new batches. Population data must be refreshed from Census releases; rankings are computed, never edited by hand without updating provenance.
population_basis: 2020 United States Census (decennial). City figures: Census 2020 via List of municipalities in Texas. County figures: Census 2020 via Greater Houston county table and Census QuickFacts. Retrieved and corroborated 2026-11-02.

Houston.area_name: Greater Houston (Houston-Pasadena-The Woodlands MSA + Houston CSA micropolitan counties)
